scope: Every signed byte pair (65,536) in each of the four DOT4 lanes with the other lanes zero: 262,144 DOT4 instructions executed by the full core. Each retirement is compared with a scalar product of the expected bytes (tests/dot4_tb.sv), the forwarded EX operands are checked per case, and the ordered checksum is compared with an independent Python scalar oracle. All 1,024 custom-0 funct3/funct7 combinations run from reset; only funct3=0/funct7=0 executes, the other 1,023 trap with no register or store side effect. Multi-lane sums are covered by directed and random programs, not exhaustively.
